coordinate_system.origin: centre of the main pod, on the plane where the glass dome meets the hull (y = 0)
coordinate_system.azimuth_zero: +X axis, angles increase toward +Z (viewed from above: counter-clockwise)

scale_basis.summary: Main dome diameter 15.2 km. The show never states a size; the only in-universe yardstick is the S3E7 street-level material (cars ~4 m) which gives tower widths and spacing, and extrapolating that to the exterior establishing shot puts the central pod at roughly the size of Brooklyn (15-17 km). The community 1:200 000 print model reaches the same Brooklyn-sized centre disc independently.
scale_basis.confidence: Shape follows the written descriptions in research.md: one revolved main pod (glass dome, raised collar, bowl hull tapering into stacked metallic plates), three 60 % copies of that pod protruding from it on organic bridges, three legs extruding downward, and a single central antenna running down the middle of the main pod, shorter than the legs. No show frame could be viewed from this environment (see research.md), so plate count, leg rake and bridge sag are the least certain values.

canonical_references.title: Close Rick-counters of the Rick Kind
canonical_references.note: First exterior establishing shot ('[Trans. Ext Citadel of Ricks]'). Rick: 'The citadel of Ricks. It's the secret headquarters for the council of Ricks.'

canonical_references.title: The Rickshank Rickdemption
canonical_references.note: Same exterior; the whole station is teleported into a Galactic Federation prison ('This area's for teleporting the entire Citadel to somewhere else using only buttons and dials').

canonical_references.title: The Ricklantis Mixup
canonical_references.note: Rebuilt Citadel, same silhouette. Street-level shots used for the scale basis.

canonical_references.title: Rickmurai Jack
canonical_references.note: Exterior seen again before Evil Morty destroys it; Mortyburg district detaches.

glass.note: Dome glass: pale teal-green against the nebula

rim_light.note: Orange light bands on collars and plate seams

bridge_tube.note: The organic connecting tube: green-grey, ribbed

pod_profile.note: One body of revolution shared by the main pod (scale 1.0) and the three satellite pods (scale 0.6). All values are fractions of the pod's dome base radius R; y is positive upward from the dome base plane.

collar.note: The 'raised piece that rests on the outside of the pod' - a proud band round the widest part, carrying the light band and hangar bays.

pod_profile.hull_note: Revolved (r, y) polyline from the underside of the collar down to the top of the plate stack; the last point closes onto the core.
pod_profile.plates_note: Several metallic plates extend from the bottom: [radius, top_y, thickness] fractions. Each plate carries an orange seam light and 16 radial greebles.

council_tower.note: Council of Ricks spire at the exact centre; the wiki's 'large statue ... in a central column' sits here.

satellite_pods.note: Three smaller domed districts protruding from the main pod; 60 % copies of it (Mortytown, Mortyburg and the third residential district). Pod 1 at 90 deg faces camera-left in the establishing shot.

bridges.note: Hybrid technical/organic connectors. The organic part is a thick ribbed tube that sags between the two hulls; the technical part is a straight truss rail above it.

legs.note: Three legs extruding downward from the main pod's lower plates, between the satellite pods, so the structure can stand on its own. Longer than the central antenna.

antenna.note: A singular centralised antenna that runs right down the middle of the centre pod, shorter than the legs.

nebula.note: Orange/brown nebula, brightest behind and slightly below the station in the establishing shot.

show_angle.note: The recurring establishing shot: three-quarter view from slightly above, pod 1 front-left.
